narrative.overview:
An open-source docs palette: bone-paper surface, diff-green additions, PR-purple accent.

As built, the portfolio reads like a well-kept repository: JetBrains Mono carries every heading, label and control, IBM Plex Sans carries the prose, and the work is presented through README devices (features as green '+' diff lines, the stack as a stack.md code block). The system is flat: no shadows and no gradients; depth is a 1px border, a 4/6/10px corner and the step between Bone Paper and README Surface bands. PR Purple is reserved: one filled action per section, plus focus rings, link underlines, card hover borders and the active nav underline; every other control is ink or outline.
keyCharacteristics: Palette: Bone Paper #f6f1e7 page, README Surface #fbf6ea bands and cards, Terminal Ink #161614 text, Comment Gray #6a6860 secondary, PR Purple #8957e5 accent (fill #7b4ad9, hover #6a3bc7), Diff Green #116329, Error Red #b42318.
Four-step type ramp: display 3.25rem mono 700, heading 1.7rem mono 600, title 0.95rem mono 600, body 0.95rem IBM Plex Sans 1.65, label 0.72rem mono 0.04em.
Flat: no shadows, no gradients; 1px borders at 28% and 60% Comment Gray; radii 4px (chips, diff lines), 6px (buttons, fields), 10px (cards, code block, chat panel).
README devices: '+' diff lines for features, stack.md code block for the stack.
12-column grid, 24px gutters, 1200px container, section padding clamp(64px, 9vw, 112px), paper and surface bands alternate.
Motion: hero staggered fade-up (16px, 0.6s, 0.1s steps), chat typing pulse, 0.2s color and border transitions; reduced motion respected.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one filled PR Purple button per section, filled at #7b4ad9 so #fbf6ea text clears 4.5:1 (on #8957e5 it is about 4.3:1). #8957e5 itself is for focus rings, link underlines, card hover borders and the active nav underline. Everything else is ink or outline; the floating chat launcher and chat send are ink.

rules.name: The Diff Green Rule
rules.body: Diff Green #116329 appears only as the text of '+' diff lines on its own 7% green tint. It marks what was built, never decoration or status.

rules.name: The Mono Structure Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono sets headings, labels, metadata, buttons and code; IBM Plex Sans sets paragraphs. Four sizes only: 3.25rem, 1.7rem, 0.95rem, 0.72rem.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadows and no gradients. Depth is a 1px border or the step between paper and surface; hover changes color or border, never elevation.

dos: Do use Tertiary for exactly one action per screen.
Do let Neutral carry the composition — negative space is a feature.
Do fill the one primary action per section with #7b4ad9 and keep #8957e5 for rings, underlines and hover borders.
Do present shipped features as '+' diff lines and the stack as a stack.md code block.
Do keep radii to 4px (chips, diff lines), 6px (buttons, fields) and 10px (cards, code block, chat panel).
donts: Don't introduce gradients. This system is flat on purpose.
Don't mix Tertiary with alternate accents; the single-accent rule is load-bearing.
Don't add shadows; depth is borders and the paper/surface step.
Don't use purple fills for persistent or repeated controls; they are ink.
